title: FLRA Authority decisions
blurb: Every decision on the Federal Labor Relations Authority's listing, 1979 to now, with full text.

joins.sql: SELECT html_url, text_status, text_source, text_chars, text FROM {file} WHERE "table" = 'authority'

covers: One row per decision on the FLRA's Authority decisions listing: 10,462 decisions, 1979-01-23 to 2026-10-30, matching FLRA's own count. Listing read 2026-11-08 (decisions through 1982 re-read 2026-11-15). Text built 2026-11-16 from pages fetched 2026-11-15 and 2026-11-16. Unofficial copy; not updated daily yet.
caveats: 4 decisions have only part of the text (Text = partial): FLRA's page is cut off and there is no PDF text. 2 have none (Text = empty): the page is title-only and the PDF is a scan with no text layer.
Text is the decision body from the flra.gov page. 36 decisions take it from the PDF instead (Text = ok_pdf) because the page has no body, is cut off or shows a different decision.
Only 1,997 decisions have a PDF link; the other 8,465 are HTML only on flra.gov.
Older decisions have no separate party list: Parties is FLRA's one-line description of the case. Six citations appear twice, as the listing has them.

columns.label: Case code
columns.help: The letters in the first case number (AR, NG, CA...). Read from the case number, not a label FLRA gives. Blank when the case number has no code.

columns.label: Parties
columns.help: The parties as the listing gives them. For older decisions this is FLRA's one-line description of the case.

columns.label: Arbitrator
columns.help: As the listing gives it, for arbitration cases. Blank on most decisions.

columns.label: Text
columns.help: ok: from the decision's flra.gov page. ok_pdf: from the PDF, because the page has no body, is cut off or shows a different decision. partial: the page is cut off and there is no PDF text. empty: the page is title-only and the PDF is a scan with no text layer.

text.label: Decision text (from FLRA's page, or the PDF when Text from is pdf; check flra.gov before quoting)
